name: Yueyang
registryBasis: The Yueyang Real Estate Registration Center is a city-local public institution. Its official portal includes a “cadastral map query” section and a public query-system entry; the public section is only a category/index, and the linked query landing page did not load. No anonymous full-polygon geometry was verified.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The public portal advertises a cadastral-map-query category, but its index page contains no map data/schema. The linked public query-system landing page timed out. No login or property-specific query was attempted.
scopeLimits: City-local official registry portal and registry-institution remit reviewed in English and Chinese discovery searches. No owner/address/tax field, account, login, or parcel identifier query was used. The linked public query-system landing page timed out during retrieval; no form was submitted.
remainingUncertainty: A public cadastral map may be behind the portal query system, but its route and data-access conditions were not established.
